newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 16 die in India landslides.
newsitem.headline: At least 16 die in India landslides.

text.p: Landslides triggered by heavy monsoon rains killed at least 16 people and injured 10 in the Darjeeling hills district of eastern India on Wednesday, police said.
"We have so far recovered 16 bodies and sent 10 people to the hospital," a senior police official Prasun Mukherjee told reporters in the eastern city of Calcutta.
He said landslides were reported from five places in and around the hill town of Darjeeling.
Mukherjee said out of the dead, seven were men, five women and four children.

Local officials said earlier on Wednesday that they expected the death toll to rise because reports of more landslides were emerging from other parts of the scenic region. Relief operations were hampered by the heavy rain, they said.
